description: This file defines the Ruleset class which encapsulates a collection of rules, parameters, and helper functions for endpoint resolution and error handling within the AWS SDK's endpoint management system. It manages rules evaluation, parameter validation, and rule creation.

classes.name: Ruleset
classes.description: A collection class that manages rule evaluation, parameter validation, and rule creation for AWS endpoint resolution.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ruleset with rules and partitions, creating parameters and rules objects.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the ruleset.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Returns the array of parameters defined in the ruleset.

methods.name: getRules
methods.description: Returns the array of rules in the ruleset.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the ruleset against input parameters, returning the first matched rule evaluation.

methods.name: validateInputParameters
methods.description: Validates and possibly updates input parameters against defined parameter constraints.

methods.name: createRules
methods.description: Creates rule instances from rule definitions using RuleCreator.
